metadata.title: Vintage Soul Portrait with High-Contrast Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, film-grain portrait of a smiling subject with arms raised, paired with a tight-kerning, high-contrast display serif in the upper corner.
triggerTerms: warm film portrait with bold serif typography
striped shirt portrait with soft lighting
excludeWhen: modern minimalist digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, slightly low-angle portrait of a woman with eyes closed and a joyful expression, wearing a vertical-striped button-down shirt. The lighting is soft and warm, characteristic of 1970s film, with a neutral, slightly textured background. A bold, high-contrast serif logo sits in the top right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's raised arms frame the face and lead the eye upward
Vertical stripes on the shirt contrast with the organic curves of the face
Warm skin tones are balanced by the cool, neutral background
Typography is placed in the negative space created by the raised arm

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and fills the majority of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical lines of the shirt up to the face, then follows the raised arms to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners around the arms and head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm brown and tan skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep reddish-brown for typography and shirt stripes
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation with a focus on mid-tones and soft highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant digital colors
Stick to earth tones and desaturated pastels

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Very tight letter spacing (kerning) where characters almost touch
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'l' with a distinct top serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold display face used for impact against a detailed photographic background.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s serif aesthetic and tight spacing
Matches the extreme contrast and ball terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s style film portrait of a person with a joyful expression, eyes closed, arms raised above head, wearing a vertical-striped button-down shirt. Use warm lighting and soft grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in the top right corner using a bold, high-contrast serif font in dark brown, with very tight kerning.

verificationChecks: Is the kerning tight enough that letters nearly touch?
Does the image have a warm, vintage film quality?
Is the subject wearing a striped shirt?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast serif typography in the top right
Ensure the shirt has vertical stripes
Verify the warm, vintage color palette
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Portrait + High-Contrast Serif + Tight Kerning + Warm Film Grain
